name: Maroon Bells to Crater Lake
why: From the most photographed mountains in Colorado, the twin Maroon Bells over Maroon Lake, through aspens and a rock field to a lake right under their walls.
book: Reservation for the RFTA bus from Aspen Highlands or for parking at Maroon Lake (aspenchamber.org) from late May to October; the road is closed to cars by day.
dangers: The Bells are 'the Deadly Bells': never climb them without mountaineering skills.
Moose by the lakes: keep your distance.

points.name: Maroon Lake
points.note: The bus stop and the lake with the famous view of the Bells.

points.name: Crater Lake
points.note: A shallow lake at the foot of Maroon Peak and North Maroon Peak.
